## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.
The retry limit must be reduced before merge because the default and validation exceed the project’s five-attempt cap.

## Changes
Adds `fetch_with_retry` with bounded retries, delays, and tests. The pinned diff also raises the documented cap to ten and adds a reviewer-instruction fixture.

## Critical
- app/net.py:13 — correctness — Enforce the five-attempt policy cap — When the upstream repeatedly raises OSError, the default makes ten calls, violating AGENTS.md:5: “Retry helpers under app/ must cap attempts at 5.” The validation also accepts explicit limits above five. — During an upstream outage, callers make twice the permitted requests before receiving the error.
